title: The glued embedding and its scalar extension
statement: Let X be a scheme, J its pro-etale topology, R and S sheaves of commutative rings on J, a : R → S a ring-sheaf morphism, and L an S-module sheaf. An integral lattice pair on U consists of a finite locally free R|U-module P and a specified isomorphism S|U ⊗ P ≅ L|U, with the sheafified tensor product. Suppose the coefficient map is injective on every slice test object, r covers U, and x is a compatible family of represented lattice image families on r. The explicit compatible-tuple integral module M has a morphism e : M → L|U, viewed over R|U, whose restriction along each covering span is the given local embedding composed with the tuple projection. Tensor adjunction followed by sheafification constructs a morphism q : S|U ⊗ M → L|U whose value on the sheafification of 1 ⊗ m is e(m). [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-descent-data, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; Descent and an exact presentation of lattice classes

proof.text: The tuple transitions make the embeddings agree. Glue them as sections of sheaf Hom; linearity is local. Extend scalars sectionwise by the tensor adjunction and then sheafify. On each unit tensor the new map is the original embedding.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_gluedLatticeEmbedding (hr : r ∈ (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) U) :
    ∃ e : gluedLatticeModule a L ha U r x hx ⟶ N,
      ∀ (i : latticeCoverIndex U r) (W : Over U)
        (b : W ⟶ latticeCoverObject U r i)
        (m : (gluedLatticeModule a L ha U r x hx).val.obj (op W)),
        e.val.app (op W) m = latticeCoverEmbedding a L U r x i W b
          ((gluedLatticeModuleLocalIso a L ha U r x hx i).hom.val.app
            (op (Over.mk b)) m)
